about_the_game:
Even dinosaurs must cope with change...

A mysterious meteor shower suddenly plunges the super-continent of Potgea into a land of... thoughts and emotions? That certainly makes things more complicated for a particular young, orange deinonychus. How will he stomach his food now that it talks back? Oh wait, he never had much of a conscience to begin with...

Join Claude, our stubborn protagonist, as he embarks on an adventure to solve this mysterious phenomena! While traveling across the wild lands of Potgea, Claude will run into prehistoric foes and dangers of all kinds. He will quickly discover that there is a good reason deinonychus typically hunt in large packs. If Claude wants to cross these harsh environments and avoid being eaten himself, he'll need to put aside his stubborn pride and team up with dinosaurs of all kinds! A sneaky, rogue-like sinosauropteryx and a stout, knight-like ankylosaurus are just a few of the possible allies our speedy ninja-like deinonychus will encounter!

In addition to unleashing "DINOMIGHT" moves in turn-based battles, Claude and friends will unearth a plethora of mini-games and side-quests to take part in for some terrific rewards! Collect and deliver eggs and dandelions, test your memory matching skills, race to finish lines and more! Even form your own team to play in the recently popular stone-passing game of "Rocker"!

Jump into this RPG of prehistoric proportions and play Claude's journey for yourself!

short_description: The dinosaurs of 'Potgea' hunt for the meanings of life in this outrageous, story-driven role-playing adventure! Traverse the wilds with species-based field skills, unleash "DINOMIGHT" moves in turn-based battles, and unearth a variety of side-quests and mini-games as you get closer to your goal!
